summary: Choose your favorite truck and race to beat the record!
description:
VVRROOOM! 
Welcome to the Racing Club!

If you have a need for speed and love racing, you've stumbled upon the perfect haven! We invite you to join our exhilarating world of Car Games for Kids, packed with high octane Racing Games for Kids.

Become a part of the fun with Truck Driver! Join the Racing Club and navigate your favorite car through the intriguing racing landscape.

Fire trucks, police cars, F1 racing cars, monster trucks, cannon trucks, ice-cream trucks, diggers, and more - the race track is all yours. Unlock rare trucks with special abilities like prop shooting and satellite signal reception. So, what are you waiting for? Gear up and discover the undiscovered!

Pick your racing beast, strap on your helmet, and get ready to rev up the engine! Choose your racing terrain - city roads, highways, underground caves, or red hills, but remember, it's not just about speed. Keep an eye out for road conditions like muddy puddles, collapsed roads, and water ponds, and try to collect as many stars as you can!

Are you ready to break the record and be a champion? Then get set and... 3! 2! 1! Go!

Features:
• Choose from 4 exciting game tracks and 18 types of unique racing trucks.
• Discover over 40 interactive animations and secret functions.
• Perfect for preschoolers aged 2-7.
• No third-party advertising.
• Works offline.
